name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
benefit: Rs. 6,000 per year to landholding farmer families, paid in 3 installments of Rs. 2,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer
eligibility: Landholding farmer families, subject to exclusion criteria (income tax payees, pensioners above a threshold, etc.)

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefit: Crop insurance covering yield loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases; low farmer premium (1.5-5% of sum insured)
eligibility: All farmers, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers, growing notified crops in notified areas

name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
benefit: Pension of Rs. 3,000 per month after age 60 for small and marginal farmers
eligibility: Small/marginal farmers aged 18-40 with up to 2 hectares of land

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Free soil testing every 2 years with nutrient and fertilizer recommendations

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
benefit: Financial assistance for adopting organic farming in clusters, including certification support
eligibility: Farmer groups/clusters willing to adopt organic farming

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Per Drop More Crop
benefit: Subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation equipment to improve water use efficiency
eligibility: All farmers; subsidy percentage varies by state and farmer category

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
benefit: Medium-to-long term debt financing for post-harvest management and community farming assets, with interest subvention
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, agri-entrepreneurs, cooperatives, and startups

name: Market Intervention Scheme and Price Support Scheme (MIS-PSS)
benefit: Procurement of pulses, oilseeds, copra and perishable horticultural produce to protect farmers from distress sales during bumper harvests
eligibility: Farmers growing covered commodities in notified procurement areas

name: Namo Drone Didi
benefit: Provides drones to Women Self Help Groups for custom-hire agricultural spraying services, generating income and improving spray efficiency
eligibility: Women Self Help Groups (SHGs), selected in phases

name: PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana
benefit: Convergence programme targeting 100 low-productivity agricultural districts, with an outlay of about Rs. 24,000 crore over six years
eligibility: Farmers located within the identified low-productivity districts

name: Gramin Bhandaran Yojana (Rural Godown Scheme)
benefit: Subsidy for construction/renovation of rural godowns to reduce post-harvest storage losses
eligibility: Farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, and agri-entrepreneurs

name: National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA)
benefit: Promotes sustainable agriculture practices including rainfed area development, soil and water conservation, and climate resilience
eligibility: Farmers in target rainfed and climate-vulnerable districts

name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
benefit: Investment support for fisheries infrastructure, aquaculture, and welfare of fisherfolk
eligibility: Fish farmers, fisherfolk, fish cooperatives, and entrepreneurs in aquaculture

name: Kisan Call Centre (KCC Helpline)
benefit: Free telephonic advisory on crops, pests, weather and schemes in local languages, toll-free number 1800-180-1551

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi (Maharashtra)
benefit: Rs. 6,000 per year state top-up to farmers, in addition to PM-KISAN, paid in 3 installments
eligibility: PM-KISAN eligible farmer families registered in Maharashtra

name: MahaDBT Farmer Mechanization & Subsidy Schemes (Maharashtra)
benefit: Subsidies on tractors, farm equipment, solar pumps, and irrigation sets disbursed via direct benefit transfer
eligibility: Registered farmers in Maharashtra applying through the MahaDBT portal lottery system

name: Krishi Bhagya (Karnataka)
benefit: Support for farm pond-based rainwater harvesting and micro-irrigation in rainfed districts
eligibility: Farmers in Karnataka, particularly in rainfed/drought-prone districts
